OrganizationUser.description:
Identity metadata returned by the organization directory.  Provider
subjects and local actor identifiers stay on the server side.

displayName.description: Human-readable name resolved from the issuer profile.

enabled.description: Whether the issuer currently permits the account to authenticate.

username.description: Current issuer username used for exact membership selection.
